description: Locations of Docked Bikeshare Stations by System and Year is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Bicycles and Pedestrians", published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Latitude and longitude for docked bikeshare stations by system and year. Data can be used to see the changes in the locations of docked bikeshare stations over time within a system. Only docked bikeshare systems open to the general public are included in the count. College, employer, and resident docked bikeshare systems are not counted. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Bicycles and Pedestrians". It has 21 columns, among them FAC_NAME, BIKE_ID, FAC_ID, the_geom, YEAR, SYSTEM_ID. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last data update. Attribution given: Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
